mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the FEDFUNDS rate increased by more than 0.25% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a quarter indicates a strengthening labor market, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE dropped by more than 0.5% in a quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A consistent increase in housing starts (HOUST) for three consecutive months signals a strengthening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and typically results in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where HOUST increased for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month indicates a contraction in supply, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market participants react to the potential economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO declined by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2%, signals a robust labor market and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) for three consecutive months, coupled with a stable or decreasing consumer price index (CPIAUCSL), indicates strong demand without significant inflationary pressure, which typically results in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase for 3 months & stable/decreasing CPIAUCSL
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% for three consecutive months signals an accommodative monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods where FEDFUNDS was below 1% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter signals strong economic growth, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where GDPC1 increased by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter.
